answer: Mechanism: Epoch-Lagged Behavioural Commitment (ELBC). Agents submit a crystal-sealed hash of a rolling feature vector—latency quantiles, task-mix entropy, inter-call gaps—over a k-epoch horizon, salted with a violet epoch nonce. Validators later sample prior commitments and require cross-epoch autocorrelation above threshold before transferring reputation. Sybils must run many independently consistent profiles across epochs, paying parallel compute, coordination overhead, and correlation-detection risk; clones failing consistency are discounted.
